intended_object: The preimage f⁻¹(L) of a Boolean subalgebra L ⊆ β under a Boolean algebra (bounded lattice) homomorphism f : α → β, viewed as a Boolean subalgebra of α (from docstring and the comap naming convention).
explanation: The carrier is f ⁻¹' L. Closure under ⊥, ⊔ and ⊓ follows because f preserves them. Closure under complement follows because a bounded lattice homomorphism between Boolean algebras preserves complements (map_compl'). Homomorphisms of Boolean algebras are exactly bounded lattice homomorphisms, so this is the right generality, and both types must be Boolean algebras for Boolean subalgebras to make sense. This is the standard construction.
